purpose: The leader row printed on each official NBA.com game card for the 2026-11-13 slate, used only for an availability cross-check: is the player a club is presenting as its leader listed on the injury report?

field_meaning.leader_player: Name exactly as printed on the game card's 'Season Leaders' block for that team
field_meaning.scope: The card labels the block 'Season Leaders'; it does not state whether the row is the league leader or that club's leader. We record it as printed and do not interpret the label.

completeness: Only the rows whose numbers were present in the retrieved page text are included. The OKC/LAC and UTA/HOU cards were truncated in the extraction, so UTA carries nulls and LAC/OKC have no row here at all. Missing rows are an extraction gap, not a statement about those teams. The GSW card row was also truncated and is therefore absent rather than guessed.
